_comment: HywMill M5 politics. Standing uses Millénaire's combined reputation (village + culture): boycott -1024, hire 4096, friend of the village 8192, one of us 32768. Outlaw: grievance >= outlaw AND reputation <= boycott, or a killing inside the village in peacetime (immediate). Pardon: grievance < pardon AND reputation > boycott. A status earned by reputation is kept down to threshold x keepFactor. Grievance: weight x insideFactor (inside the village) x selfDefenseFactor (the victim struck first), halving every halfLifeDays. Favor is earned only by service (no trade source) and capped. Cultures patch fields.
